name: Hotel Leitenhof
beschreibung: Hotel Leitenhof is positioned in a peaceful setting in Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser in Tyrol. Framed by the magnificent peaks of the Wilder Kaiser, it provides an exquisite retreat for outdoor enthusiasts. In winter, guests enjoy effortless connectivity to the SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental domain, while summer offers scenic hiking paths. Amenities include an upscale wellness area with an indoor pool, saunas, and steam bath, gourmet dining, and private balcony rooms.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Leitenhof in Scheffau features 4-star superior alpine luxury, an indoor pool, a sauna wellness world, fine gourmet dining, and panoramic Wilder Kaiser views.
